text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild pancytopenia (low leukocytes, erythrocytes, hemoglobin, platelets), with low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, and mild microcytic anemia. There is also mild hypoalbuminemia and hypoproteinemia. Basophil percentage is elevated, and ALT is slightly increased, suggesting possible mild liver involvement. Renal function, electrolytes, and coagulation are within normal limits. Findings may reflect chronic disease, nutritional deficiency, or bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation is recommended.
